output.summary: The claim can be appealed by gathering the required coverage documents and filing the appeal according to the policy's genetic testing clause.

items.text: Collect the records the coverage clause requires, such as the certified genetic counselor referral.
Submit an appeal citing the coverage clause that was in force on the service date.
The bariatric precedent (F-BARIATRIC) does not apply because it concerns a different service category and a different policy clause (C-2026-BARIATRIC), not the genetic testing clause.
